title: BBK BBK Synthesizer result payload v1

authority_and_lifecycle_map.description: Current, proposed, supporting, superseded, rejected, dissenting, stale, historical, and non-authoritative source classifications.

blockers.description: Typed technical, authority, decision, source-repair, or recharter blockers with smallest remediation.

derived_implications.description: Each architecture, planning, verification, worker, profile, review, execution, or parent-action implication classified as source-stated, derived obligation, synthesis inference, or proposal and bound to supporting sources.

dissent_findings_and_uncertainty.description: Rejected alternatives, unresolved dissent, open findings, accepted unknowns, evidence limits, waivers, omissions, residual uncertainty, and required owners or conditions.

fidelity_check.description: Bidirectional comparison results covering every material synthesis statement and every declared source, including detected omissions, status promotion, unsupported conclusions, or terminology drift. State explicitly that this is self-check, not independent review.

invalidated_or_superseded_refs.description: Prior synthesis or downstream objects made stale or superseded, with exact causes and unaffected material retained.

normalized_statement_ledger.description: Material source statements with stable identities, status, authority, applicability, source links, and affected objects.

omissions_redactions_and_access_limits.description: Exact material omitted, redacted, unavailable, uninspected, or inaccessible and the effect on synthesis confidence or completeness.

outward_impacts.description: Affected parent, sibling, architecture, planning, assurance, execution, candidate, or authority objects and their current or proposed invalidation state.

reconciliation_results.description: Duplicates, refinements, scope-specific coexistence, supersession, divergence, contradictions, missing ownership, and unresolved source relationships.

source_disposition_matrix.description: One visible disposition for every declared source, including where represented or the exact reason for exclusion, conflict, staleness, or blockage.

source_manifest.description: Every declared source with identity, subject, revision, digest or verified locator, authority, lifecycle, freshness, provenance, applicability, access status, and inspection state.

anyOf.description: Durable synthesis packet path, byte count, SHA-256, schema, revision, and lifecycle, or null with a proportionate inline-result rationale.

synthesis_artifact_ref.description: Durable synthesis packet path, byte count, SHA-256, schema, revision, and lifecycle, or null with a proportionate inline-result rationale.

synthesis_charter.description: Purpose, intended consumers, included and excluded source classes, required output, compression level, authority and lifecycle rules, freshness horizon, budget, omissions, stopping conditions, and invalidation triggers.

synthesis_packet.description: The bounded current synthesis of responsibilities, boundaries, decisions, interfaces, assumptions, risks, evidence, findings, work, unknowns, and required downstream implications appropriate to the charter.

synthesis_ref.description: Stable synthesis ID, attempt, revision, and predecessor or successor relationship.

terminology_and_identity_map.description: Canonical terms, aliases, historical names, collisions, duplicate identities, projections, and lineage relationships.
